scope: Map tools only; no bulk downloads, real map database access, physical devices or network configuration changes.

public_direct_probe.result: 1/1 valid JPEG via socket-bound enp14s0 plus one startup probe

features_verified: Small --test follows selected zoom/profile; cached samples decoded read-only without creating map data
HTTP200 HTML and truncated PNG/JPEG cannot be saved; quiet retry succeeds or reports final exhaustion
Resume streams only a 32-byte header, 12-byte trailer and length only, retaining good cached coords and requeueing obvious corruption
One bounded SQLite writer; resume completes before concurrent HTTP writes to avoid pool timeout spam
Direct-route shared circuit recovers after a 30-second cooldown without reducing HTTP concurrency
Default high zoom includes URRG; RRLS only UB/URRG/Midland with a 22,724,018,176-byte worst-case plan below the 50,000,000,000-byte total cap
Targeted --repair-tile bounded to 32 tiles with profile/zoom/resume checks, cannot combine with --test or bundle rebuild; fetches no unselected tiles
Failed explicit repair preserves old target and unselected data; valid replacement handles even internally-corrupt images with good headers

Legacy atomic file writes honor disk reserve with 32-writer / 32 MiB headroom (all 32 maximum-size bodies plus 16 MiB allocation margin); low-space refusal preserves existing tile and creates no partial file
limitations: Header-only resume is not a full compressed-image integrity scan; --test checks only selected sample coordinates and --repair-tile repairs explicit targets.
Stop the downloader after checkpoint before inspecting an existing cache; a nonempty WAL is refused by the immutable read-only probe.
Public direct-interface test validates this Linux host only; macOS auto-detection is covered by parser tests, not live interface use.
No bulk-provider throughput or complete dataset download performed during this audit.
